submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 4 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.244% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a significant improvement over the baseline (3.2% at 5mm) and substantially outperforms the other candidate materials: F1 achieves 3.843% at its optimum (6mm), and F2 achieves 5.076% at its optimum (6mm). The systematic sweep of plate thicknesses from 2-10 mm for all three materials confirms that F3 at 4mm is the global optimum. All materials meet the critical residual dose rate constraint of ≤20 μSv/h at 1m after one week of cooldown, allowing hands-on maintenance. The recommended configuration satisfies all project constraints while delivering superior performance for the forward electromagnetic calorimeter.
